# `rm_polar_align_image`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delete both saved polar-alignment WCS image files.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit and 32-bit builds, by command-socket invocation, which always writes shared diagnostics); the effect of the handler itself is probable |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcbce0, RmPA_WCS @0x160410 (64-bit build) |

Removes the two saved slot files. Removal results are ignored, so the call succeeds even when files are missing. The stored solve dates and the slot selection are not reset.

Side effects: Deletes the two pa_N WCS files from device storage.

## Example

Request, remove:

```json
{"id":61,"method":"rm_polar_align_image"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"rm_polar_align_image","result":0,"code":0,"id":61}
```
